stem:
Vihaan studies a mango tree. Food is made in the leaves. A growing shoot tip and a ripe mango later hold stored food that was not made in those parts themselves. Water and minerals also move in the tree.

How does food made in the leaves reach the growing tip and the mango?

options.text: Roots make the food and send it through phloem to the leaves.
Starch in the mango proves the food was made in the mango.

teacher.key_rationale: Leaves make food by photosynthesis; phloem carries that food to growing and storage parts. Xylem carries water and minerals, roots do not make the food, and stored starch in a mango does not prove it was made there.
